segments.name: Tim Hortons
segments.description: Runs the Tim Hortons brand's coffee and food business in China, serving consumers through stores, delivery and e-commerce.
segments.evidence: after the disposal of Popeyes, one reportable segment, which is Tim Hortons.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for Tim Hortons products, ordered in stores, for takeout through delivery platforms or Weixin mini programs, or on Tmall.
revenueModel.evidence: Customers may place takeout orders for our products through online food ordering and delivery platforms or our Weixin mini programs.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company disposed of its Popeyes China operation, leaving Tim Hortons as its one reportable segment.
changes.evidence: On June 28, 2024, the Company disposed Popeyes China operation to PLK (See Note 2(b)).
